verdict.label: Heavy review / verification
verdict.summary: Meta Ads requires creating a Business App, adding the Marketing API, completing Business Verification, and undergoing App Review for advanced access to manage other users' ad accounts.

composioFit.summary: Meta Ads does not have a Composio-managed OAuth app, so you must bring your own custom OAuth app and wire your Client ID and Client Secret into Composio.
whyOwnApp: Required for custom scopes and dedicated provider quota
Allows custom OAuth branding and redirect URIs

phases.name: Create App in Meta Developer Portal
steps: Go to the Meta App Dashboard and create a new app.
Select the appropriate app type and add the Marketing API product.
phases.handoff: Copy your App ID and App Secret into your environment.

phases.name: Configure Auth & Redirect URIs
steps: Set up the Composio auth config to retrieve your unique redirect URI.
Add the redirect URI in your Meta app settings.
phases.handoff: Ready to test authentication with your own developer account.

phases.name: Complete Business Verification & App Review
steps: Connect your app to a verified Business in the Business Manager.
Submit for Advanced Access and App Review for ads_read or ads_management permissions.
phases.handoff: Wait for Meta to approve your App Review submission and Business Verification.

redirectRules.rule: Must use the exact redirect URI provided in the Composio auth config dashboard.

blockers.cause: Exceeded ad account rate limits while in the Marketing API development tier or hitting mutation limits.
blockers.fix: Upgrade to Full access of Marketing API Access Tier or space out requests.
blockers.fallback: Reduce request frequency and implement exponential backoff.

blockers.symptom: Calls to this api have exceeded the rate limit. (Subcode: 4841018)
blockers.cause: Concurrent frequent POST requests targeting the same object causing database lock contention.
blockers.fix: Avoid editing the same object too frequently, space out requests, and retry at least 30 seconds apart.
blockers.fallback: Queue requests sequentially per object ID.

blockers.symptom: You can only change your account spending limit 10 times per day. (Subcode: 1885172)
blockers.cause: Exceeded the maximum allowed changes to the ad account spend or spend_cap fields.
blockers.fix: Wait until the next day to make more changes or reduce frequency of updates.

checklist.text: Create a Meta Developer account and register a new App.
Add the Marketing API product to your Meta app dashboard.
Set up a custom auth config in Composio and copy the redirect URI.
Configure the redirect URI and OAuth settings in the Meta App Dashboard.
Connect your app to a Business Manager entity and complete Business Verification.
Submit permissions (ads_read, ads_management) for App Review if managing external ad accounts.
